top_signals.title: Gold Inches Higher as Traders Monitor Oil Prices, Fed Rate Path
top_signals.summary: Gold edged higher as oil prices eased, with traders looking to US inflation data due later this week for clues on the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: MI5 Boss Says UK Must Prepare for Hybrid Warfare Tests by Russia
top_signals.summary: The head of MI5 warned Britons must be resilient in the face of “escalating” Russian hybrid warfare, as the UK’s domestic security service devotes more resources to hostile state threats than during the Cold War.
